description: I'm Islam Ahmed , a Renewable Energy Engineer and Director of Project Management at Enactus NCTU. I blend green tech, AI, and structured leadership to turn big ideas into reality. We are building "Mars Wars," an interactive educational space game. Join me if you value an organized, execution-focused environment! I'm actively looking for Game Developers, UI/UX Designers, and Content Writers to complete our roster. Let's build something amazing!
